title: Zesty Roasted Dutch Chicken Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Dutch stew made with roasted chicken, birds-eye chillies, and a blend of aromatic spices, perfect for a springy date-night dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large hot-pot vessel, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced birds-eye chillies and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion and cook for 3 minutes, until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken thighs and cook for 5 minutes, until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, chicken broth, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cover the vessel and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast for 30 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
